name: Jenny Guo
title: Co-Founder
bio: Jenny Guo is an Emmy award-winning creative producer celebrated for her pioneering work at the intersection of VR, blockchain, and the arts. As the co-founder of Highstreet, Jenny is leading the charge in crafting commerce-driven MMORPG games using VR and Blockchain technology. Honored on Forbes 30 under 30 in 2018, AACYF 30 under 30 in 2020, and as one of the top 10 Asian American entrepreneurs in 2021, Jenny's accolades are a testament to her innovation and influence in the digital realm. Jenny's VR endeavors have received international acclaim, amassing awards from Asia and the U.S. She has championed VR art installations in collaboration with esteemed artists such as Rachel Maclean, Wang Xin, and Tian Zhuo Chen. With a profound background in art dealings spanning China and the U.S., Jenny offers a unique lens to the global arts panorama. Beyond her entrepreneurial pursuits, she holds the title of a Sundance fellow and is a distinguished researcher at the Harvard Visualization Lab. Ms. Guo has spoken at multiple conferences including Harvard Graduate School of Design, SXSW, Wharton School of Business, J.P Morgan, TEDxBohaibay, Sotheby's' and Christie’s.
